        "body": "When import blocks were first introduced they had to be fully static, which allowed them to be validated during the configuration loading process. This early static validation was carried forward as more features were introduced, but that led to some validation in awkward places like the graph builder, and some validation which could not be done like validating the `to` expression.\r\n\r\nMoving the import validation into the validate graph allows us to more fully validate the block contents, in the same way as normal resource configuration and mostly unifies where validation happens. We still have a couple outliers due to the possibility of config generation, which requires some checks in the config transformer for entirely missing modules when the resource has no config, and the plan node to suggest config generation if the resource has no configuration.\r\n\r\nNow that `Validate` handles most of the actual validation, I inserted `Validate` calls before the import `Plan` calls in tests, or replace the `Plan` calls entirely when it was clear that the desired diagnostics had moved into `Validate`. This was to leverage the existing tests both for the new code, and to verify there are no test regressions since `Validate` would always be called during a plan from the command line.\r\n\r\nFixes #35516",

All done. The full `internal/terraform` suite passes (99 targeted import/validate/deferred tests pass, whole package `ok`).

## Summary

Implemented the fix for `terraform validate` not validating `import` blocks, mirroring upstream PR #35543 ("core: move import validation into the validate graph"):

- **`internal/terraform/context_validate.go`** — pass `ImportTargets: c.findImportTargets(config)` to the validate graph builder, so import blocks participate in the validate walk.
- **`internal/terraform/node_resource_validate.go`** — added `validateImportTargets` (evaluates `id`/`to`/`for_each` expressions during validate, catching undefined variables/locals), `validateImportTargetExpansion` (count/for_each key agreement), and `validateConfigGen` (config-generation eligibility); `Execute` now runs import validation even when resource config is nil.
- **`internal/terraform/transform_config.go`** — unclaimed import targets are now added to the graph as validation nodes instead of only during config generation; `validateImportTargets` only checks that the target *module* exists.
- **`internal/terraform/graph_builder_plan.go`** — `ConfigTransformer` also skips `walkDestroy` (not just `walkPlanDestroy`).
- **`internal/terraform/eval_import.go`** — `evaluateImportIdExpression` no longer takes a target (self-ref check moved to validate).
- **`internal/terraform/node_resource_plan.go`** — plan-time import expansion now calls `validateImportTargetExpansion`, and un-configured single targets without `-generate-config-out` get a helpful error.
- **`internal/terraform/eval_for_each.go`** — `ImportValues` rejects non-iterable `for_each` values instead of panicking.

`go.mod`/`go.sum` untouched; no test files modified. Note: `internal/command` tests can't run in this dev container because the Go module proxy is unreachable (`AlecAivazis/survey` etc. missing from the offline cache) — pre-existing environment limitation; the fix lives entirely in `internal/terraform`, which builds, vets, and passes all tests.
